capabilities: Track prioritized next steps with drag-and-drop ordering
Seal letters to a future date and deliver them when it arrives
Save one-line lessons and find them with fuzzy search
Render Markdown details and checkboxes inside steps and letters
Show everything on a dashboard, optionally in a sidebar tab
extras: Notes live in Kedge/Letters, Kedge/Next-Steps and Kedge/Lessons with frontmatter fields such as status, priority, snooze_until, seal_date and order; no default hotkeys ship, so users assign their own.
motivation: The author wrote it to help keep himself on track and to match how he thinks and processes information.
problem: Obsidian has no single place to keep a ranked next action, an idea to resurface on a set date, and a lesson worth remembering later.

relations.evidence: Install BRAT, then Add beta plugin → assaf/kedge

summary: Dashboard plugin for prioritized next steps, letters sealed until a future date, and searchable one-line lessons.
